for.zh: 自有房屋的人：保房子本身、屋內財物、你的責任，和修繕期間的暫住
for.en: People who own their home: the building, what is in it, your liability, and somewhere to stay during repairs

questions.en: How old is the building, in years?

options.en: Ground floor, a house, or basement

questions.zh: 房子本身重建要多少錢？（不含土地；不確定可用每坪 1,800 美元估）
questions.en: What would rebuilding the home cost? (not the land; about $1,800 a ping if unsure)

questions.zh: 屋內財物重買要多少錢？
questions.en: What would replacing what is inside cost?

questions.zh: 過去三年申請過幾次房屋類理賠？
questions.en: Home claims in the last three years?

coverages.zh: 建築物本身（火災、颱風、地震、水管破裂）
coverages.en: The building (fire, typhoon, earthquake, burst pipes)

addons.zh: 地震加強（建築保額 100%，含地震後火災）
addons.en: Earthquake plus (the full building limit, fire after a quake too)

claims.zh: 颱風打破門窗或外牆受損
claims.en: A typhoon broke windows or damaged the outside

claims.zh: 水管破裂造成屋內損壞
claims.en: A burst pipe damaged the home

claims.zh: 漏水弄壞樓下鄰居的房子
claims.en: Water from my home damaged the flat below

clauses.zh: 「建築物」指承保地址的房屋主體結構、固定裝修和固定設備（如門窗、廚具、衛浴、固定式冷氣），不含土地和公共設施。公寓大廈只保你專有的部分。
clauses.en: "The building" is the home's structure, fixed fittings and fixtures (doors, windows, kitchen, bathroom, fixed air conditioning) at the insured address, not the land or common areas. In a block of flats, only your own unit.

clauses.zh: 「重建成本」指以同等材質和規格重建或修復建築物所需的費用。建築物以重建成本理賠，以保單所載建築保額為上限。
clauses.en: "Rebuild cost" is what rebuilding or repairing the building in similar materials costs. The building is paid at rebuild cost, up to the building limit.

clauses.zh: 建築物因火災、雷擊、爆炸、颱風、洪水、地震、水管破裂或第三人車輛撞擊而毀損時，我們支付修復或重建費用，扣除自負額。地震損失以建築保額的 30% 為上限，加保 HO-5.1 者為 100%。
clauses.en: When the building is damaged by fire, lightning, explosion, typhoon, flood, earthquake, a burst pipe or someone else's vehicle, we pay to repair or rebuild it, less the deductible. Earthquake loss is paid up to 30% of the building limit, or 100% with HO-5.1.

clauses.zh: 屋內財物因 HO-2.1 所列事故或竊盜而毀損或滅失，我們依重置成本扣除自負額理賠。竊盜須於 24 小時內報案。單件超過 1,500 美元而未加保 HO-5.2 者，以 1,500 美元為上限。
clauses.en: Contents damaged or lost through an HO-2.1 event or theft are paid at replacement cost less the deductible. Report a theft to the police within 24 hours. A single item over $1,500 not listed under HO-5.2 is paid up to $1,500.

clauses.zh: 你因所有、使用或管理承保房屋之過失，對第三人負損害賠償責任時，我們代為賠償，每一事故最高 20 萬美元。未經同意不得承認責任或和解。
clauses.en: When you are liable to someone else through negligence in owning, using or looking after the home, we pay, up to $200,000 per event. Don't admit liability or settle without our agreement.

clauses.zh: 承保事故使房屋無法居住時，我們支付暫住費用，每日最高 150 美元，合計最高 6,000 美元，最長 60 日。
clauses.en: When an insured event makes the home unliveable, we pay to stay elsewhere, up to $150 a day and $6,000 in all, for 60 days at most.

clauses.zh: 故意行為、詐欺，或你本人、同住家人或其指使之人所造成的損失，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for loss caused on purpose or by fraud, or by you, family living with you, or anyone acting for them.

clauses.zh: 自然耗損、年久失修、白蟻、黴菌、逐漸滲漏、施工瑕疵、地層下陷，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for wear and tear, neglect, termites, mould, slow leaks, faulty workmanship or subsidence.

clauses.zh: 保單生效後 14 日內發生的事故，除火災和竊盜外，不予理賠；保單生效時已發布颱風陸上警報者，該次颱風不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for events in the first 14 days, except fire and theft; and none for a typhoon whose land warning was already out when the policy started.

clauses.zh: 戰爭、核子事故、政府徵收，以及房屋連續空置超過 60 日期間的竊盜與水損，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for war, nuclear events, expropriation, or theft and water damage while the home has been empty more than 60 days in a row.

clauses.zh: 申請理賠時須提供事故經過、時間地點、照片及修繕估價。損失超過 5,000 美元時，我們可以派員或委託公證人查勘；查勘前請勿拆除受損部分，但為防止損失擴大的必要處置除外。
clauses.en: To claim, tell us what happened, when and where, with photos and a repair quote. For losses over $5,000 we may send an adjuster; don't remove damaged parts before that, except what is needed to stop further damage.

clauses.zh: 提供不實資料或隱匿重要事實者，我們得拒絕理賠並終止保單。
clauses.en: False information or a hidden important fact lets us refuse the claim and end the policy.

clauses.zh: 每一事故扣除一次自負額；同一颱風或地震（含 72 小時內的餘震）視為一次事故。
clauses.en: One deductible per event; one typhoon, or one earthquake with its aftershocks within 72 hours, is one event.

clauses.zh: 地震加強：地震及地震引起之火災，以建築保額 100% 為上限理賠。
clauses.en: Earthquake plus: earthquake and fire caused by it are paid up to 100% of the building limit.

clauses.zh: 貴重物品逐項列載，以列載金額為上限，含遺失與意外損壞，不扣自負額。
clauses.en: Listed valuables are covered up to their listed amounts, loss and accidental damage too, no deductible.

clauses.zh: 保費月繳或年繳；月繳扣款失敗有 14 日寬限期，逾期停效，補繳後復效，停效期間的事故不予理賠。可隨時退保，按未經過日數退費；可隨時變更，立即重新計價。
clauses.en: Pay monthly or yearly; a failed monthly payment has 14 days' grace, then the policy lapses until paid, and events while lapsed are not covered. Cancel any time for a refund of the days left; change any time, priced again at once.

clauses.zh: 保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池，用於理賠與再保險；年度結算後剩餘部分捐給你所選的公益團體。
clauses.en: 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee; the rest goes to the claims pool for claims and reinsurance, and what is left after the year closes goes to the cause you chose.
